implementation: standalone Python read-only consumer; NOT ces.cli.v1, NOT native Collect:ProposedPR

default.response: EC163 path metadata nested under path_evidence; patches=[]; patch_content_collected=false

content_gate_all_required: Valid prior full ces.proposed_pr_identity.v1 result, with expected pin and matching request locator
Explicit allow_network true, TLS-authenticated fixed-provider read and valid token supplied separately
Explicit include_patch_content true at the call site
Explicit acknowledge_provider_permission true: caller declaration, NOT independent provider entitlement proof
Explicit ContentPolicy with 1..5 exact safe changed destination or deleted origin paths; no glob, no sensitive paths
Explicit bounded positive per-file and total UTF-8 output budgets
EC163 pre AND post immutable pin match, provider change-count stability, safe path/status/pagination, coverage.state COMPLETE
All selected paths exactly match the verified sanitized changed-path metadata
Full bounded text passes binary/size/control-character/sensitive-pattern/syntax refusal policies

response.path_evidence: Unmodified ces.proposed_pr_paths.v1 result, or null for preflight denial. Its patch_content_collected flag remains false by design.
response.patch_text: Only non-null for explicitly selected, fully bounded AVAILABLE entries after all EC163 guards complete
response.content_granted_success_means: Only limited selected patch text was emitted following completed path and pin observations; not an authenticated/atomic diff snapshot, provider permission proof, merge or delivery attestation

availability_states.MISSING_OR_BINARY_UNKNOWN: Provider omitted patch/diff or sent null; cannot distinguish binary without positive marker
availability_states.EMPTY: Present empty string; no content emitted
availability_states.BINARY: Provider content explicitly contained binary-diff marker
availability_states.BINARY_OR_BINARY_SUSPECTED: Selected file has binary-typical suffix or provider binary flag; conservative block, not positive binary proof
availability_states.PROVIDER_COLLAPSED: GitLab collapsed file diff; no expansion/read of another endpoint
availability_states.PROVIDER_TOO_LARGE: GitLab too_large flag; no expansion/read of another endpoint
availability_states.TOO_LARGE: UTF-8 patch byte count exceeds selected per-file cap; no prefix emitted
availability_states.TOTAL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Total visible output budget exhausted; no suffix or prefix emitted
availability_states.TRUNCATED: Declared unified diff hunk lengths were not satisfied by the provided snippet; no content emitted
availability_states.UNVERIFIED_FORMAT: Nonempty text fails conservative syntax check; no content emitted
availability_states.SENSITIVE_CONTENT_BLOCKED: Potential secret literal detected; entire snippet blocked
availability_states.SENSITIVE_PATH_BLOCKED: Known private path denied before transfer/read, not emitted as a patch entry
availability_states.UNSAFE_TEXT_BLOCKED: Forbidden control/format text; no content emitted
availability_states.INVALID_PROVIDER_CONTENT: Provider patch/diff field had invalid type or encoding
availability_states.COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE: EC163 source count/path pagination incomplete or unknown; ALL patches suppressed

refusal_semantics.preflight_invalid_input: No provider/token requests. reason_code identifies input gate.
refusal_semantics.provider_or_pin_error: Mirror EC163 status and reason; suppress ALL captured content, release no patch entries.
refusal_semantics.incomplete_coverage: Return partial/2, each selected availability COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE, every patch_text=null.
refusal_semantics.any_selected_path_missing: Return invalid_input/4, patches=[]; suppress content from other selected paths.
refusal_semantics.some_files_withheld: Return partial/2, explicit availability for each selected path; only AVAILABLE paths contain text.
refusal_semantics.synthetic: Even a complete simulated fixture may only return partial/2; is not a live authorization example.

integrity_limitations: Two matching EC162 pin observations plus count/coverage do not prove a cross-page atomic snapshot; EC165 remains unimplemented.
A syntactically well-formed patch may still omit entire hunks or be stale; availability AVAILABLE does not mean complete file diff.
GitHub may omit patch for binary or other reasons; omission is deliberately not labeled definitely binary.
Caller permission acknowledgment and successful API read do NOT cryptographically attest source-code sharing rights or user identity.
Secret/path heuristics are defense in depth, not comprehensive data loss prevention; treat authorized stdout as sensitive.
Provider JSON pages may already carry patch/diff fields even when content output is disabled; bounded in-memory transport and parse is unavoidable for these APIs.
No patch bytes are cached, persisted, logged, fetched via raw-diff endpoint or written to a local code repository by the tool.
